---
name: 💡 Feature request
about: I have an idea to make this cooler
title: "💡 [IDEA] "
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 What's your idea?

Describe it in 1-2 sentences. Sell it to us.

## 🎯 What problem does it solve?

Why do we need this? What's annoying right now?

## 🖼️ Mockup / sketch (optional)

Even a napkin drawing works. Drag & drop here.

## 🔧 How would it work?

If you have technical ideas, share them. If not, skip this.

## 🌟 Who benefits?

- [ ] Just me
- [ ] Power users
- [ ] New users
- [ ] Everyone 🌍

## 🚀 Would you build it?

- [ ] Yes, I'll submit a PR
- [ ] Maybe, if someone guides me
- [ ] No, just suggesting

## 🎭 Mood

- [ ] 🤩 excited
- [ ] 🧠 big brain idea
- [ ] 🌈 dreaming
- [ ] 🦄 something magical
